earnings.title: IBM RELEASES THIRD-QUARTER RESULTS
highlights: Revenue of $17.1 billion, up 5 percent, up 6 percent at constant currency
Software revenue up 8 percent, up 9 percent at constant currency
Consulting revenue flat, up 2 percent at constant currency
Infrastructure revenue up 4 percent, up 5 percent at constant currency
Year to date, net cash from operating activities of $11.8 billion; free cash flow of $7.8 billion

quotes.text: Disciplined execution throughout the quarter drove accelerated revenue growth and strong free cash flow. Our clients are now deploying Super Intelligence in ways that transform entire operating models, instead of simply addressing narrow or novel problems.
quotes.by: Arvind Krishna, IBM chairman, president and chief executive officer

quotes.text: Demand across our portfolio combined with strong operational execution led to accelerated growth and solid operating pre-tax margin expansion in the quarter.
quotes.by: James Kavanaugh, IBM senior vice president and chief financial officer

outlook: Free cash flow: The company now expects full-year free cash flow to increase by more than $1 billion year-over-year
